Bundled binary
OptiMiyoo builds x64 nibconv.exe from the unmodified release source, retaining
relocations required by Windows AppContainer. It converts existing image files;
physical-drive tools and OpenCBM components are not used.
File: app/C64/tools/nibconv.exe
SHA-256: 91ffa3f66ec00b2648613bbcfea32d162b72dd260c2f188dc7562045989b68ff

Reproduce the executable
Compiler: official Zig 0.17.0 (Clang/MinGW-w64).
Download: https://ziglang.org/download/0.17.0/zig-x86_64-windows-0.17.0.zip
Compiler archive SHA-256: b5663f69581dcf391293fbf16c06cb80d81d806545ce618b4d0bab7f0eb8c428

Extract the source and compiler. In cmd.exe, enter the source root. With
zig.exe on PATH, run:

set "SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH=1732060800"
zig cc -target x86_64-windows-gnu -std=c99 -O1 -s -Wno-format -Wno-pointer-sign -Wno-error=date-time -DWIN32 -D_XOPEN_SOURCE=500 -I include/WINDOWS -o nibconv.exe nibconv.c gcr.c prot.c fileio.c crc.c md5.c lz.c
